name: postgres
title: PostgreSQL
description: A PostgreSQL 17 database on a volume, backed up daily, with Adminer to look into it.
notes: Adminer is at https://{{domain}}, behind Team only: its user name is team, and its password is shown once after Create. To log into the database from Adminer choose System PostgreSQL, Server postgres, Username app, Database app, and the password you typed. Other apps can't reach this database by name: services find each other only inside one app. To use it from your own services, add them to this app's Compose file (Configure, Compose). Backups run every day at 03:00 UTC.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Adminer domain
inputs.help: Where Adminer is served. Its DNS must point at this server.

inputs.name: db_password
inputs.label: Database password
inputs.help: The password of the app user. Keep a note of it: Caravana never shows it again.
